fix.rootCauseConfirmed: CONFIRMED. The CUDA device-side assert originates in the reduced-row `_scan_arm` (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py, emitted helper, original lines ~1465-1485). The arm passed `ssm_state_indices=ssi0.index_select(1, idx)` + `num_accepted_tokens=nacc.clamp(max=m)` to `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update`. Reading the live kernel (/tmp/vllm_live_019/vllm/model_executor/layers/fla/ops/fused_sigmoid_gating.py:113-130): with IS_SPEC_DECODING (num_accepted not None) the kernel loads the INITIAL state index at column `i_t = num_accepted_tokens[i_n]-1`, then dereferences `p_h0 = h0 + state_idx*stride_init_state_token` where h0=ssm_state (the live multi-bank recurrent cache). For the reduced M5/M1 arm, `ssi0.index_select(1, idx)` builds a [1,m] table whose columns hold the per-tree-NODE banks of the selected rows; the bad index is `state_idx = ssi0[0, deep_row]` (the deep node's column) which is a BRANCH/LEAF cache bank, not a valid recurrent prior-state bank -> out-of-range/invalid bank -> OOB global read at fused_sigmoid_gating.py:130 (b_h += tl.load(p_h0...)) -> device-side assert on the first cat9 tree-verify forward (task w68z6gxgy, both boots, CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 confirmed hook is first-faulter; research/fr13_workflows/gdn_subop_ab_crash_wf_e3fc5285.raw.json /result/verdict/nextAction). The geometry is wrong because the served forward (line 4994) feeds the WHOLE tree as one varlen sequence with cu_seqlens=[0,tree_n] and ssm_state_indices=full [num_spec,max_path_len]; slicing rows via index_select(1) for a reduced arm scrambles the kernel's per-timestep column<->bank contract.
fix.fixApplied: Applied the verdict's 1-row-initial-state-at-bos=0-valid-bank fix in scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py. `_scan_arm` now takes a `served_geom` flag (call sites updated at ~:1688-1691: M10 full=True, M5/M1 reduced=False). For served_geom=False (reduced M5/M1 arms) it builds `scan_indices = torch.full((1,m), prior_conv_bank, ...)` where prior_conv_bank=int(ssi0[0,0]) (the committed/decode prior bank that already holds the deep node's spine prior recurrent state) and passes `num_accepted_tokens=None` so the scan kernel reads its initial state at column 0 (= that valid bank) and stores per-timestep into that one bank in the CLONED ss (observe-only) — never indexing the live multi-bank cache by a branch/leaf bank. The M10 served arm keeps `ssm_state_indices=ssi0.index_select(1, range(tree_n))` + raw nacc (faithful served reference; in-range by max_path_len>=tree_n). `_conv_arm` already used the single valid bank ssi0[:,0]; added explicit row+bank guards and nacc.clamp(min=1,max=m).
fix.boundsGuards: Every index/bank/seqlen is now guarded with a clean Python `raise RuntimeError` BEFORE any native kernel launch (a CUDA assert is a GPU-runtime fault CPU tests cannot catch). Guards added (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py, helper): (1) `_guard_rows` — each selected row in [0,tree_n) AND < max_path_len (the latter prevents the index_select(1,idx) OOB which is itself a CUDA assert); called at the top of both _conv_arm and _scan_arm. (2) prior_conv_bank=int(ssi0[0,0]) validated in [0,n_conv_banks) AND [0,n_ssm_banks) where n_conv_banks=conv_state_snapshot.shape[0], n_ssm_banks=ssm_state.shape[0]. (3) final scan bank-table range guard: iterate scan_indices values, allow PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 (kernel skips it, fused_sigmoid_gating.py:127-129), else require 0<=bank<n_ssm_banks — covers BOTH the M10 served table and the reduced full() table. (4) init-state column guard: when scan_nacc is not None, assert nacc-1 in [0,m) (the kernel's i_t=nacc-1 initial read column). conv arm uses single valid bank + clamped nacc. Verified by negative tests: OOB prior bank (999) and row>=max_path_len both fire the guard and block the kernel with zero records written (no vacuous record, class-9 fail-loud); valid geometry passes through (existing wiring test writes exactly 1 record).

verify.cudaSafetyAudit: CONFIRMED all reduced-row indices provably in-range; the invalid-bank assert cannot recur. Read live kernels: fused_sigmoid_gating.py (init read :113-130 i_t=nacc-1 then state_idx=ssm_state_indices[i_t], deref h0+state_idx*stride; store loop :171-180 derefs ssm_state_indices[i_t] for EVERY i_t in [0,T) — so all m columns are dereferenced, not just the init one) and causal_conv1d.py update kernel (:816-821 reads conv_state_indices[idx_seq*stride+conv_state_init(=0)]; :859-861 conv_state_token_offset=nacc-1; cols read at offset..offset+width-1 unmasked on token axis). Guards in scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py (helper ~:1447-1589) cover EVERY native index: (1) _guard_rows: each selected row in [0,tree_n) AND < max_path_len (the latter blocks the index_select(1,idx) OOB which is itself a CUDA assert) — called at top of both arms unconditionally; (2) prior_conv_bank=ssi0[0,0] validated in [0,n_conv_banks) AND [0,n_ssm_banks); (3) FINAL scan bank-table guard iterates ALL scan_indices values (covers M10 served table's per-node banks AND the reduced full() table, AND the store-loop columns), allows only -1 (PAD, kernel skips at state_idx<0) else requires [0,n_ssm_banks); (4) init-column guard nacc-1 in [0,m). Reduced arms additionally pass num_accepted_tokens=None (init at column 0 = the one valid committed bank) so the deep node's branch/leaf column is never read. RESIDUAL GPU-ONLY RISK (one, low): the conv arm's token-offset = conv_nacc-1 reads conv_state tokens [offset..offset+width-1] with NO explicit token-axis bounds guard in the helper — BUT it is bounded-by-inheritance: conv_nacc=nacc.clamp(min=1,max=m), m<=tree_n, so offset<=tree_n-1<=served nacc-1, and the served forward already invoked causal_conv1d_update with offset=nacc_served-1 against the SAME conv_state buffer without OOB; the M10 clamp max=tree_n keeps it <= served bound. So it is safe by inheritance from the served contract, not by an explicit assert — a defensive token-offset+width <= conv_state_snapshot.shape[2] guard would harden it but is not strictly required. Net: the specific invalid-bank scan assert (the actual crash) is provably eliminated; the only un-asserted path is conv token-offset which is provably <= the served-validated value.
